description: Identify CNS field values — NVMe Base Spec 2.0a, Figure 273

0x00.name: Identify Namespace
0x00.description: Returns Identify Namespace data structure for NSID

0x02.name: Active Namespace ID List
0x02.description: Returns list of active NSID values > NSID field

0x05.name: I/O Command Set specific Identify Namespace
0x05.description: Returns I/O CS Identify Namespace data structure

0x06.name: I/O Command Set specific Identify Controller

0x07.name: I/O Command Set specific Active Namespace ID List
0x07.description: Returns I/O CS active NSID list

0x08.name: I/O Command Set independent Identify Namespace
0x08.description: Returns I/O CS independent Identify Namespace

0x10.name: Allocated Namespace ID List
0x10.description: Returns list of allocated NSID values > NSID

0x11.name: Identify Namespace (allocated)
0x11.description: Returns Identify Namespace for allocated NSID

0x12.name: Controller List (attached to NS)
0x12.description: Returns list of controllers attached to NSID

0x13.name: Controller List (all in subsystem)
0x13.description: Returns list of all controllers in subsystem

0x14.name: Primary Controller Capabilities
0x14.description: Returns Primary Controller Capabilities data structure

0x1A.name: I/O CS specific Identify Namespace (allocated)
0x1A.description: Returns I/O CS specific Identify Namespace for allocated NSID

0x1B.name: I/O CS specific Allocated NS ID List
0x1B.description: Returns I/O CS specific allocated NSID list
